title: Finish One Pantry
user: A household that buys repeat packages and wants a low-effort way to know when a replacement belongs on the list.
smallest_useful_product: Offline mobile PWA with a pinned shelf of recurring packages and one Finish button that decrements a simple reserve count and adds an item to a local list at the chosen threshold.
success_measure: After 30 days, 60% of pilot users still record at least three finish events per week and report fewer than one surprise stockout for tracked items.
constraints: No product database or retailer data; exportable local JSON; work one-handed; tolerate missed events without claiming inventory precision.
